_comment: Maps each git branch to the Steam Workshop item it publishes to. This file is identical on
the beta and main branches on purpose: it is the one place that knows about both, so a merge
between the branches never conflicts here. scripts/dev.sh reads it and writes workshop.json
and workshop/mod_id.txt from it at release time.
tagSuffix makes the tag vX.Y.Z + suffix. '-beta' is also a semver pre-release, so v0.7.0-beta
sorts before v0.7.0, which is the order the two branches actually ship in.
gameBranch is the Steam branch the build targets. 'public-beta' is the BetaKey that Steam
writes into appmanifest_2868840.acf; the default branch writes no BetaKey at all.
descriptionBanner is the [quote] block at the top of the Workshop description that says which
game branch this item is for and links to the other one. The body below it is shared, so this
is the only part of the description that differs. release rebuilds it from here every time,
stripping any existing banner first, which heals the wrong banner arriving through a merge.
minBranch/maxBranch are Steam's supported game-version range for the item, written by release.
The game reads them in ModManager.CheckSteamBranchSupport and refuses a mod whose range does not
cover the branch being played, showing MOD_ERROR.STEAM_BRANCH_UNSUPPORTED rather than loading it
and failing later. Valid names: public, public-beta, private-beta, dev-test. Empty means open.

beta.title: The Alchemist (Beta Branch)
beta.descriptionBanner: [quote]This mod is for the beta version of the game. Here is the public version: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3781688551[/quote]

main.title: The Alchemist
main.descriptionBanner: [quote]This mod is for the public version of the game. Here is the beta version: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3780726901[/quote]
